newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's April industrial output rises 10.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's April industrial output rises 10.7 pct.

text.p: South Korea's industrial output in April rose 10.7 percent year-on-year, up from an 8.4 percent rise a year earlier, provisional National Statistical Office (NSO) figures showed on Friday.
Note: figures in percent, year-on-year change.
The NSO figures showed industrial output rose 3.0 percent in April from March against a 1.6 percent rise a year ago and a rise of 1.5 percent in March.
Output in April inproved due to an increase in 64 megabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chip production and exports of vehicles.
The office said output of semiconductors in April rose 55.4 percent on the year, while office and accounting equipment such as personal computers increased 46.9 percent.

Output of heavy industrial goods in the month rose year-on-year 14.7 percent against a 10.4 percent rise a year ago, while that of light industrial goods fell 4.2 percent, against a rise of 1.3 percent.
The office figures showed ex-factory shipments for exports in April increased year-on-year 14.7 percent, against a 16 percent rise a year before.
Shipments to the domestic market rose 6.1 percent, the same growth pace as a year ago, the office said.
The fall in inventories was pronounced in the steel and chemical product sectors.
